description: For a scoped formula \(A\) with \(n\) available slots and no free-variable names, and terms \(t_0,\ldots,t_{n-1}\) using \(k\) retained slots, the simultaneous scoped instance \(A[t_0,\ldots,t_{n-1}]\) fills each available slot with its corresponding term and shifts internal binder slots to follow the retained slots.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Skolemization.Prenex.fill.{u', v'} {L' : FirstOrder.Language} {n k : ℕ}
  (φ : L'.BoundedFormula Empty n) (ts : Fin n → L'.Term (Empty ⊕ Fin k)) : L'.BoundedFormula Empty k
